title: Endpoint Raw Telemetry — Base Schema v1
description: Common required fields for all raw endpoint telemetry sent to /v1/ingest. Event-specific schemas extend this via allOf.

ts.description: Event timestamp — ISO-8601 UTC (e.g. 2026-05-15T08:00:00Z). Use the time the event occurred on the endpoint, not the agent submission time.

event_type.description: Specific event type within endpoint telemetry.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier. Used as idempotency key — must be stable if the same event is resent.

host.description: Hostname or device identifier of the source endpoint.

user.description: Username in whose security context the event occurred.

event_source.description: EDR agent name or vendor identifier (e.g. 'defender-atp', 'crowdstrike-falcon').

risk_score.description: Agent-assigned or heuristic risk score in range [0.0, 1.0]. Omit if not available.
